Hi there,

Since the original admin left without a hand‑over, the workspace ownership can’t be changed via a self‑service option. You’ll need to contact our support team and provide the details of the new point of contact (name, email, company affiliation, etc.). A human reviewer will verify that the requester represents the same company and then complete the ownership transfer for you.

Let us know if you need any help submitting that request.
